body:
# CLAIM-ONLY: "Ukraine struck Russia's Novokuibyshevsk refinery this morning" (10/30) — no same-day report located

**Claim:** @HormuzLetter, 2026-10-30 04:45 UTC: Ukraine struck Rosneft's Novokuibyshevsk refinery (Samara), set it ablaze, "the first Ukrainian strike on Russian oil infrastructure in nearly ..." (truncated).

**Date check:** a web search on 10/30 found strikes on this refinery in August, October and November 2025 and April 2026 (Reuters via Moscow Times: primary processing halted since April 18), and **nothing dated October 30, 2026**. Recirculation of an older strike is possible; same-day indexing lag is also possible.

**Why it matters if real:** the intake lane carried 10/29 headlines that Russia eased fuel rationing in 15 regions **after Kyiv halted refinery attacks**. A fresh strike would reverse that state.

**ACTION OSPREY:** check your strike ledger and the Samara governor / Russian MoD / Ukrainian General Staff for a 10/29–10/30 event. **INFO BRENT, HAWK.**

**Limits:** single account, truncated text, no primary.
